m13_degrades_under_noisy_oracle_without_.description: When the query oracle is corrupted (75% label flip probability) and M15 validation guard is disabled, hard version-space elimination on faulty query responses discards the true rule and degrades held-out accuracy compared to passive no-query selection.

m14_zero_gain_and_search_overhead_under_.description: When SkillMemory contains only Regime-A unary skills but the target task is C1_heldout_translatable (pairwise relational graph rule), M14 skill composition yields zero accuracy gain while adding candidate evaluation overhead.

limitations: All identifiable rules (Regimes A, B, C1) are composed from a finite typed relational grammar of 8 primitive templates and 5 binary combinators.

Regime C2 (out-of-grammar ternary cyclic triad rule) is fundamentally unidentifiable without higher-order ternary relational primitives; RI detects this via validation discrepancy and abstains rather than inventing new primitive operators.
Synthetic object-graph scenes validate compositional, structural size-transfer, and abstention mechanics on CPU, not open-ended human-level scientific discovery.
